def create_dependency_tree(items):
    # Build a map of item names to items for quick lookup
    items_by_name = {item.name: item for item in items}
    all_names = set(items_by_name.keys())

    # The result stages - each stage contains items that can run in parallel
    stages = []
    placed_names = set()

    # Process items in their original order to preserve order
    remaining = list(items)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        current_stage = []
        next_remaining = []
        for item in remaining:
            if item.name in placed_names:
                continue
            if not item.depends:
                current_stage.append(item)
                placed_names.add(item.name)
                changed = True
            else:
                # Check if all dependencies are already placed
                if all(dep in placed_names for dep in item.depends):
                    current_stage.append(item)
                    placed_names.add(item.name)
                    changed = True
                else:
                    next_remaining.append(item)
        if current_stage:
            stages.append(current_stage)
        remaining = next_remaining

    # Check for remaining items - they have unmet dependencies
    if remaining:
        missing_deps = []
        circular_items = []
        for item in remaining:
            for dep_name in item.depends:
                if dep_name not in all_names:
                    missing_deps.append(f"{item.name} depends on missing: {dep_name}")
            if all(dep in placed_names for dep in item.depends):
                # Circular dependency detected
                if item.name not in circular_items:
                    circular_items.append(item.name)
                    text = f"Circular dependency detected: {item.name}"
                    raise DataError(text)
        if missing_deps:
            text = "There are unmet dependencies using #DEPENDS. " + "; ".join(missing_deps)
            raise DataError(text)
        else:
            # No missing deps but items remain - potential circular dependency
            if circular_items:
                text = "There are circular dependencies using #DEPENDS. " + ", ".join(circular_items)
                raise DataError(text)
    
    return stages
